subject: 嵩山中岳庙 · 峻极殿中央立面局部
author: Windmemories
source_note: 选2026年正面实拍可见的中央部分，明确为九间殿堂中的五间局部，不据树木遮挡猜画完整翼部。
prompt: Produce a fine black-line architectural DETAIL plate of the CENTRAL FRONT of Junji Hall 峻极殿, Zhongyue Temple, using the second photograph. First Longmen Buddha image establishes ONLY fine contour line style. This is explicitly a cropped architectural study of central facade, NOT a speculative complete reconstruction. Retain the center FIVE bays, with six red-column positions translated to unfilled outline, the TWO stacked palace roof eaves above, the tall decorative frieze between roofs, rectangular blank plaques, and the central terrace stair with two parallel flights separated by an imperial stone ramp plus stone railings. The entire hall has nine bays, but the outer four bays are not included in this detail drawing. Both roof contours and terrace edges gently finish as light broken contour strokes toward white side margins, NOT a falsely complete small five-bay roof. Preserve the roof's very broad shallow pitch and distinct doubled eaves; no central finial. Remove all trees/snow, visitors, kiosks, metal railings, incense burner and little ancillary shrines that block the facade; do not invent sculptures or fill openings black. Show only the clear stable structure from the central part of the photo, its five door bays and steps, consistent symmetry. Match master with sparse thin exact black strokes on pure white, open airy visual density, roof tiled with just a handful of long lines, simplified bracket outlines and very little ornamental linework. No gray fill, no shading, no hatching, no black blocks, no text at all. Centered landscape 1536x1024, generous white top and bottom and white margins.

site_recommendation.name: 嵩山中岳庙
site_recommendation.lede: 峻极殿以重檐庑殿和高台石阶形成中岳庙的中心。古树间显露的中央立面，让五岳祭祀建筑的尺度与礼序仍然可读。
facts: 峻极殿全殿面阔九间、进深五间，现存面貌以清代营造和后世修缮为主。
正面古树遮挡两翼，本图只取中央五间及石阶，屋檐向两侧淡出表示局部。
中岳庙沿革可追溯到早期山岳祭祀，不能把建庙沿革年直接当成现存峻极殿年代。
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1750为清代现貌约略排序，非峻极殿确切重建年；1986年曾大修。
